name: @quest-city-web/staff-identity
description: WEB-M3B: staff/teacher identity, authentication, authorization, dashboard review and teacher feedback (02_35 v1.0, 02_26 v1.8 §31). Entirely separate identity domain from @quest-city-web/identity's student model — no shared table, cookie or credential mechanism (class_access_code, PIN, student_session). Reuses (never duplicates) tenant/class/student/enrollment read repositories and the learning_attempt ledger.
